rules.runner: production extractor Role emitted before annotation

local_selection.selection_reason: The incumbent was retained because no challenger cleared every frozen switch condition. Gemma-4-26B-A4B-QAT led the incumbent by 2 correct labels, below the required advantage of 4.
local_selection.parameter_policy: There is no parameter-count ceiling. Locality, artifact authorization, exclusive residency, and the runtime gate determine whether a model may compete.
local_selection.catalog_rule: Any model already stored and served on the ZBook may compete. A linked or Dynamo catalog entry is not local and must not be loaded, called, or unloaded.

pilot_result.interpretation: This pilot selected one local arm. It is not evidence that any role is recoverable; only the frozen 200-unit per-role evaluation answers that question.

runtime_policy.locality: Only LM Studio residents and catalog rows whose deviceIdentifier is null are ZBook-local. LM Link rows, colon-prefixed paths, and every Dynamo resident are forbidden.

preferred_device_load_transaction.before_load: Capture lms link status --json and the exact original preferredDeviceIdentifier, set the preferred device to the local ZBook deviceIdentifier, and verify that preference before resolving or loading a candidate.
preferred_device_load_transaction.load: Resolve the requested artifact to exactly one non-linked local catalog path, require a full-GPU estimate, load it while the ZBook is preferred, and verify that the resulting sole resident is local and has the requested identifier and settings.
preferred_device_load_transaction.after_load: Immediately after loading and verifying the exact local candidate or restored incumbent, restore the captured preferredDeviceIdentifier in a finally path and verify the restoration. Failure, interruption, or Ctrl-C does not waive restoration.
preferred_device_load_transaction.unload: Before every unload, temporarily prefer and verify the ZBook again, re-read process state and match the exact authorized local row, unload only its exact identifier, verify that no local row remains, then restore and verify the captured preferredDeviceIdentifier.
preferred_device_load_transaction.prohibition: A preferred-device transaction authorizes only the exact ZBook-local artifact; it never authorizes loading, calling, or unloading a linked or Dynamo model.

runtime_policy.residency: Exactly one ZBook-local LLM and zero ZBook-local embedding models may be resident during a run. Candidates are loaded and evaluated sequentially.
runtime_policy.gpu: The pre-load estimate must report 100% GPU offload, and the loaded candidate must remain fully GPU-resident.
runtime_policy.lifecycle: Snapshot the pre-existing incumbent and every restorable load setting, unload it, require zero local residents between candidates, unload only the exact AutoTLDR-owned candidate after its run, and restore the incumbent exactly even after failure or interruption.

frontier.requests: one independent ephemeral invocation per item
frontier.isolation: new empty directory, read-only sandbox, no inherited environment, user config, rules, repository context, web search, or tools
frontier.methodology_limit: The subscription CLI exposes neither temperature, seed, nor max-output-token controls and adds the Codex execution surface. This arm is a pragmatic frontier ceiling, not a bit-for-bit match to direct API sampling.
